  "markdown": "### 3.1 Primary Objective

The primary objective is to evaluate whether Drug X 350 mg IV every 3 weeks improves the objective response rate (ORR) compared to docetaxel in adults with previously treated advanced melanoma.

- **Primary Endpoint:** Objective Response Rate (ORR), defined as the proportion of participants achieving a confirmed complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) per RECIST 1.1, as assessed by the investigator.
- **Timepoint:** ORR will be assessed from randomization until disease progression, start of new anticancer therapy, or death, whichever occurs first, with a minimum follow-up of 52 weeks. The primary analysis will be performed when all participants have completed at least 24 weeks of follow-up or have discontinued earlier.

### 3.2 Secondary Objectives

Secondary objectives include:

1. To evaluate progression-free survival (PFS) of Drug X versus docetaxel. [TBD: define PFS endpoint and timepoint]
2. To evaluate overall survival (OS) of Drug X versus docetaxel. [TBD: define OS endpoint and timepoint]
3. To evaluate the safety and tolerability of Drug X compared to docetaxel. [TBD: define safety endpoints and timepoints]"
